title: [Master] - Bug 644751 Moving an expense report line to another report wrongly reports a duplicate
summary: Moving an expense report line to another open expense report no longer raises a false duplicate expense violation. The duplicate check no longer compares the moved line against its own source line.
key_points: The duplicate check no longer treats a moved line as a duplicate of its originating line
Removes false duplicate warnings when a line is moved between open expense reports
Real duplicates within or across reports, including posted ones, should still be detected
Small change (+2 -2) in the Expense Report Line table of the Expense Agent app
